svg.title: Blueprint sheet 18, the boat: a company that belongs to what it is for. After the Purpose network, steward-ownership

g.text: to what it is for, not to whoever can buy it
the boat belongs to its work,
work for what it is for.
for a while, then lets go.
nobody can buy the boat to cash it in.
the money goes to the owner.
the old saying: leave it better than you found it.
after the Purpose network. for example:
a living blueprint for a world
